propositions: git fetch origin tickets fails with exit 128 but the error message discards git's stderr, making the root cause undiagnosable
dc_store_copy_repo uses subprocess.run with capture_output=True and check=True, which suppresses git's diagnostic output and raises CalledProcessError with only the exit status
the fetch is an unretried network call on the critical path, so any transient failure takes the entire test as ERROR
git archive and git ls-tree calls in dc_store_copy_repo have the same diagnostic problem as the fetch
a new _run_git helper must capture and include git's stderr verbatim in the raised error along with the command, remote, branch and exit status
the fetch call must retry a bounded number of times with backoff before failing permanently, so transient errors do not red the lane but genuine misconfigurations still do
